title: Partners
lead: What carriers, pickup points and other partners tell us, and how their systems connect.
portalLead: Parcels at your company, proof of handing over, cash to pass on, and notices to Tracecart. Never prices or margins.
pickupsLead: Parcels waiting at a pickup point. The customer's six-digit code releases them. Proof and cash are on each parcel's page.
deliveriesLead: Parcels assigned to you that are moving. Record news, a photo or signature, then delivery — and the exact cash on a cash order.
sendHint: It goes to Tracecart's staff, not the customer. To change a parcel's status, use its page.
noSuchShipment: None of your shipments has this reference.
shownOnce: Copy it now. It won't be shown again.
confirmRevoke: Stop “{name}” working, at once? Anything using it will stop.
keyNameHint: What it's for, such as “Tracking system”.
webhookUrlHint: On their own server, in https.

scopeHints.shipments_read: See their shipments and inbound shipments, with no prices.
scopeHints.shipments_write: Report status changes and news on their shipments.
scopeHints.shipments_cod: See the total to collect on cash orders, and record delivering them.
